title: StoreOS
tagline: A live map of where things actually are in a store, built by scanning while you work.
stateNote: The demo uses a fictional store, Fernwood Market, with simulated history.
problem: Inventory systems describe what a store should look like. Workers live in what it actually looks like. StoreOS treats every scan, put-away and 'not here' as an observation.
audience: Store workers and retail operations people.
contribution: It is my project: an Android-first progressive web app with a demo store.
worksToday: Try the demo store with two weeks of simulated crew history.
Set up a store by photographing aisle signs or by typing aisles in, per the README.
limitations: The demo store and its history are fictional and simulated.
I haven't tested it in a real store.

involve.headline: Work in a store?
asks: If you work in a store, tell me where the model is wrong.
